Neon Debt -- v0.1.0
=====================

KEYS
----
  Move left                   A / Left    gamepad: D-pad left
  Move right                  D / Right    gamepad: D-pad right
  Up (menus, doors, lifts)    W / Up    gamepad: D-pad up
  Down (menus, drop through)  S / Down    gamepad: D-pad down
  Jump (hold for height)      Space    gamepad: A / Cross
  Dash                        Shift    gamepad: RB
  Melee                       J    gamepad: X / Square
  Ranged                      K    gamepad: LB
  Cast a hack (costs RAM)     L    gamepad: Y / Triangle
  Next hack                   E    gamepad: RS
  Previous hack               Q    gamepad: LS
  Talk, use, pick up          F    gamepad: B / Circle
  Map                         M
  Gear and stats              Tab    gamepad: Back
  Pause / back                Escape    gamepad: Start

A gamepad works; so does the keyboard. Both are listed above.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU
---------------------
Play until you are done or until you are stuck. Then tell us where you
stopped, anything you looked at and could not reach, and whether you
would pick melee, ranged or a hack if you had to keep only one. If you
got stuck, say what you tried.

This is a vertical slice: one district, one boss, thirty to forty-five
minutes. Nothing here tells you what to do on purpose -- if you cannot
work out where to go, that is the thing we need to know.
